title: The Charger's approach cap is in
author: Blitzwing (Tank Designer-Developer)
body: Nye approved the balance fix: an evolved Charger now has to stop at least 60 units from its target and steer at least as carefully as the scripted Charger. It can still be more careful, never more reckless, the same rule we use for dodging. Stats, presets and the scripted tanks don't change.

The old pinned champion was a bulldozing Charger, so we re-ran its evolution under the new rules. This time a Sniper comes out on top. The old nightly lineage is archived and the next nightly starts fresh at Gen 0.
next: Watch the first nights of the new lineage, and consider judging promotion against past champions too.
